text:
maria: Heads-up — coordinating docs + console work for the 1.12.0 release. We need to sequence SDK docs regen, console metadata bump, and docsite cache invalidation so customers don't hit stale SDK snippets. Target release window is Tue 09:00 PT.

kevin: I can take the SDK regen job, but last run flaked on mac-latest (filewatcher timeout). Which SDK targets?

maria: @kevin thanks. Targets: python, js, and go. Also need the types package bump: python client -> 1.12.0, js -> 0.10.0. Changelog entry for batching token semantics is missing — @oliver can you add a short note?

oliver: on it. I'll add a line under "Behavior changes" with the PR link. PR #4923 contains the runtime change.

sophia: Quick ask — docsite edge TTL is 15m right now, should we force invalidate after deploy? We had a few customers hit stale examples previously.

maria: Yes, plan: staggered deploys. Steps: (1) regen SDK docs, (2) merge docs PRs to release branch, (3) run docsite deploy to staging, smoke, then promote to prod and trigger edge invalidation. If any SDK snippets fail, revert the snippet PRs.

kevin: Regen command I'll run:
```
./ci/regen_sdk_docs.sh --targets python,js,go --out public/sdk --concurrency 4
```
I’ll post logs here. If it errors on mac-latest I'll retry on ubuntu-latest and pin python to 3.11.

docs-bot: Docs CI job queued: docs-regen/472 (owner: kevin). ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: scheduled docsite deploy to staging at 08:20 PT, promotion to prod at 09:05 PT if smoke passes.

maria: @sophia can you run the staging smoke (login + a quick SDK sample run) at 08:30? Minimal checklist: 1) sample auth flow works, 2) code snippets compile for py/js, 3) console route examples show correct model name/version.

sophia: Yep, I'll do the smoke. I also have a tiny helper script to run the python snippets:
```
python -m examples.run_samples --dir public/sdk/python --token $REDWOOD_TOKEN
```
Will report failures here.

oliver: Changelog entry added in #4981, short note + link to migration steps. Also updated the release notes section about SDK version pins.

kevin: Docs regen finished. Two warnings: one missing snippet in python/examples/advanced.md (PR #4992) and one flake on mac-latest which retried on ubuntu and passed. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/job/472/logs

maria: Great. @kevin can you open a tiny PR to add the missing snippet or point to the sample file? If it's quick, merge before docsite deploy.

kevin: PR #4993 opened with the snippet fix. Linking it to the release branch now.

docs-bot: Docsite deploy to staging succeeded. URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.example/1.12.0

sophia: Smoke results: auth ok, py/js snippets run, console examples show model=redwood-1.1. Confirming the changelog blurb is visible. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promoting site to prod at 09:05 PT. Edge invalidation requested (Fastly purge).

maria: Thanks team. After prod promote, I'll do a quick console metadata bump for routes that reference SDK versions. If anyone sees customer-facing regressions, ping #support and I'll roll back the site.

kevin: Noted. Will monitor errors and watch the SDK download counts.

oliver: One follow-up: we should add a short blurb in the release checklist to run the regen on ubuntu if mac-latest flakes — saves time. I can add that to the template.

maria: Please do. Closing this thread after prod confirm.

deploy-bot: Prod deploy completed at 09:06 PT. CDN purge completed.

maria: Confirmed prod live and snippets look good. Thanks all! :tada:
